changes.summary: Restricted public build egress to hosts used during Dockerfile execution.
changes.details: Removed nvcr.io because digest-pinned base images are fetched through the separate verified base-image transfer and the build runs with pull disabled.

changes.summary: Refreshed the pinned core runtime to ComfyUI 0.34.0.
changes.details: The source bundle now hash-locks stable tag v0.34.0 at exact commit 12d52794 and its verified source archive. Model artifacts, core-node workflow parameters, admission envelopes, and Candidate qualification are unchanged.

changes.summary: Identified the BF16 ComfyUI path as a quality-reference variant.
changes.details: Published its exact single-Spark memory and peak installation-disk envelopes and points operators to FP8mixed when headroom matters. Candidate qualification is unchanged.

changes.summary: Replaced per-job shard merging with Comfy-Org's upstream-supported monolithic checkpoint.
changes.details: The recipe now installs the exact monolithic transformer, scaled-FP8 encoder, and VAE as ordinary core-node files, supports one or two signed reference-image inputs plus a bounded prompt file, and declares one PNG output.

changes.summary: Hardened shared ComfyUI job result selection.
changes.details: Jobs now fail closed on missing, empty, multiple, or unexpected media outputs before atomically publishing one declared result.

changes.summary: Declared the complete recipe contract installable without changing Candidate qualification.
changes.details: The execution contract was already structurally complete; this release makes it available for explicit operator installation while physical build and Spark acceptance remain separate.

changes.summary: Initial candidate two-reference core-node ComfyUI release for Qwen Image Edit 2511 BF16 on a single Spark.
